name: seal-install
description: Installs Sealmetrics on a site from scratch: creates the site, plans the snippet and the funnel with you, writes them, simulates them against the real tracker before anything ships, then confirms the first hit and each event on the live site. Carries the local MCP server, the only one that exposes the provisioning, planning and verification tools.

api_key.title: Sealmetrics API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave it empty if you have no Sealmetrics account yet: the plugin creates a free one from the chat. If you have one, paste an API token from my.sealmetrics.com → Settings → API Tokens. Stored in your system's secure credential store and passed only to the bundled Sealmetrics MCP server.
